reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) demonstrates TWIP and TRIP activation by interstitial carbon in a metastable f.c.c./h.c.p. HEA, but the hypothesis applies this to a single-phase BCC refractory HEA (NbMoTaW) without any cited evidence that such mechanisms occur in BCC systems or that the severe lattice distortion of NbMoTaW supports them. The leap from the cited f.c.c.-based system to the proposed BCC system is unsupported.
premises: Interstitial carbon in HEAs can jointly activate TWIP and TRIP mechanisms.
The TWIP/TRIP mechanisms improve ductility while maintaining or enhancing strength.
The severe lattice distortion in multi-principal-element alloys supports these deformation mechanisms.
The proposed mechanism is applicable to a BCC refractory HEA like NbMoTaW.
